resolution: Fixed the side-vs-front desk collision mismatch by removing the remaining radius-square prop path from live host physics. Rectangular props now expose propOrientedPhysicsRect with their measured local X/Z half extents, embodied play includes prop solids directly, and the older state/hostPhysics packer sends rectangular props through the oriented-rect wire instead of the flat radius/AABB rect path. Added a focused world/props test asserting imported.desk uses the 2.309897m by 1.149652m measured rectangle and not the coarse radius square.
